Shipping Services

One network, every speed

From an envelope that can't wait until morning to a full container crossing an ocean — pick the service that fits the deadline.

USP Priority Overnight Next day by 10:30

Our fastest door-to-door service for urgent parcels and documents, with money-back guarantee on the delivery time.

USP Express 1–3 business days

Time-definite air shipping to major cities worldwide, customs brokerage included on international lanes.

USP Ground 2–5 business days

The economical workhorse for everyday parcels — day-definite delivery with full tracking at ground rates.

USP Freight & Ocean Pallets to containers

LTL, air freight and ocean forwarding with warehousing, consolidation and end-to-end supply-chain management.

Help & Support

Answers, fast

The questions we hear most. Still stuck? Call USP support any time at 1-800-USP-SHIP — lines are open 24/7.

Enter your 12-digit USP tracking number in the Track tab above. You'll see every scan along the route, a map of where the package is right now, the latest delivery estimate — and, once it's delivered, the courier's delivery photo. You can also track up to 25 shipments at once with a free USP account.
The estimate is the date (and, for Priority services, the time) we commit to deliver by. It updates automatically if weather, customs or network events affect your shipment's route.
Rates are based on the route, the greater of actual or dimensional weight, and the service speed you choose. Use the Quote tab above for an instant estimate before you ship.
In most cases, yes. Track the shipment, then choose "Manage delivery" to hold it at a USP location, redirect it to a new address, or reschedule the delivery day. Some changes carry a small fee.
Hazardous materials, perishable food on standard services, cash and certain regulated goods are restricted or prohibited depending on the destination country. Check the restricted-items list for your destination before booking, or ask our team — we'll tell you straight.
